verifier: independent subagent, 2026-10-29; own code (verify_p.py, verify_t.py, verify_t2.py, verify_synth.py, check_tokens.py); no import of mixture.py/track_p.py/synthetic.py/trackT/* or prm_boost_collection_v1. Frozen package spectral_utils.fusion_utils.lsml_continuous_guarded used only for the optional L-SML parity re-run. sklearn 1.9.0, numpy 2.4.6.

check1_track_p_primary.note: Identical fits (same data order, sklearn seed); clean_closed/err_kept identical, so no fit differences to explain. Pass rule follows: |pi_hat-pi| <= .05 in 0/4 cells on ProcessBench (.125,.080,.246,.078), 0/4 on Hard2Verify (.449,.293,.286,.227), 0/4 on PRMBench; Track P FAILS its pre-registered rule, as reported. Gate-useful (>=30% clean closed, >=85% errors kept): ProcessBench qwen_prm_72b (.904/.908) and rlhflow_prm (.450/.911) only, as reported.

findings: mixture.py: labels enter only score() (evaluation of a finished fit) and auc().

track_p.py: fit_cell uses step risk (reward / score__PRM) and covariates only; the label loader lab() is a closure invoked in main() after all four fits of the cell. Note: for PRMBench/Hard2Verify, evaluate_collection.load() materializes per-step labels (c.err/c.keep) in the same Cell object at load time, but they are not read by check_raw, residualize or fit_mixture (confirmed by reading).

trackT/track_t.py: parity + all fits use FEATURES.npz, REWARDS[rewards] and token counts; processbench_gold.json is opened only after the fits dict is complete. REWARDS.npz also holds native_labels (the PRM native flags, not gold) and is not used. ext.Population/cell_bank use random keys and answer-z, no labels.

trackT/extract_answer_tokens.py reads only idx and step_token_spans; the raw records do contain error_steps (gold) but it is not read. build_bank_external.py manifest records labels_read: false (not re-audited line by line).

prmbench.note: 176 non-control clean = 160 with empty error_steps + 16 whose only error steps are out of range (pre-registered in-range rule).

check4_parity.non_circular: track_t.py compares against STORED/SCORES_CHAIN_qwen_prm.npz = hd_collection_data/processbench_scores (file mtime 2026-10-20, AIRCC bank path in its JSON), which track_t.py never writes (it writes only PARITY.json/TRACK_T*). Verifier re-ran L-SML on its own answer-z N16 bank built from the rebuilt FEATURES and reproduced stored TELE_N16 to 4.0e-14 and CHAIN_N16 to 2.6e-12.
check4_parity.note: N16 channels rebuilt vs bank_v3 differ by <= 5.1e-14 (all 56 channels <= 2.7e-9); rewards identical. digit_active is True on all 25,697 steps for all three digit channels, so the active-step masking is a no-op in this cell.

check_tokens_covariate.note: PB_QWEN_ANSWER_TOKENS.npz answer_tokens equal sum(hi-lo) of raw step_token_spans for 3400/3400 answers (pickle loaded with python -I from verification/).

check5_track_t.note: All three arms reproduced (T-LSML/T-CHAIN from the verifier's own L-SML fit). |pi_hat-pi| = .172/.156/.105 vs Track P .125: only T-CHAIN is closer than Track P but none <= .05; Track T FAILS, as reported. No arm is gate-useful (err_kept .625/.667/.751 < .85).

findings: (a) No true mixture: BIC prefers 2 components in 5/5 replicates for t3 and log-normal, raw and Yeo-Johnson (reported 20/20). Log-normal raw pi_hat .205 (ref .205), YJ .460 (ref .476); t3 pi_hat unstable, .11-.82 raw (ref .21-.96).

(b) True mixture: pi_hat is not recovered within .05 except near d=2 with t5 noise/prev .65 (rep0 .607, err .04) and roughly prev .65 d=2 Gaussian (.566, err .08). d=1 collapses toward ~.5 (prev .20 -> .47-.50; prev .65 -> .50-.58), and BIC rejects 2 components for Gaussian d=1. prev .20, d=2 Gaussian gives .37 (ref .38). Replicate-0 values agree with the reported ones within normal sampling variation.
Reported conclusions (BIC invents a second group on unimodal heavy-tailed/skewed data; pi_hat poorly recovered unless separation is large) hold.

could_not_do: Secondary variants (top-2 mean, Yeo-Johnson) of Track P/T were not re-derived; only primary rows (plus synthetic YJ).
build_bank_external.py / rebuild_source_bank_v4.py were not re-implemented; the rebuilt bank was checked only against the independent AIRCC bank_v3.
